ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels across the central ventral surface, contrasted with 15% low-intensity black pixels located at the peripheral margins, tips, and localized spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the majority of both lobes; a consistent low-intensity black border (5-15 pixels wide) follows the trailing edge and tips; discrete dark circular blobs are visible in the mid-left lobe and proximal to the median notch; complex black-and-white mottled cluster at the peduncle insertion point.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees; notch depth occupies approximately 12-15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along the entire trailing edge; left lobe exhibits higher-amplitude peaks (spikes) compared to the right lobe; prominent notch at the far-left trailing edge before the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge geometry follows a concave curve from the median notch, transitioning into a broad convex sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Small cluster of dark circular spots (3-4 points) visible near the medial-lower region of the right lobe; extensive high-contrast mottling at the fluke base.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A distinct, dark linear disruption (~25 pixels) oriented diagonally on the inner right lobe, originating near the median notch area and extending towards the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible diagonal linear scar on the right lobe; irregular pigmentation and likely scarring at the caudal peduncle interface.
other_distinctive_markers: The right distal tip exhibits a more acute, attenuated point compared to the slightly more rounded left tip; the left lobe trailing edge contains a significant 'step' or notch near the outer third of the span.
